machine_checks.scope: source identity/version, HDF5 geometry, quality/injection policy, deterministic processing, lag invariant, adversarial failures, and clean replay

agent_reproducibility_review.scope: portable execution, identity/provenance completeness for the declared path, resource reporting, and conclusion strength
agent_reproducibility_review.limitations: No independent custody and no human domain authority.

separate_executor_clean_checkout_replay.scope: Fresh clone, detached commit identity, locked environment materialization, packet/source identity audit, clean replay, and isolated beyond-tolerance and lock-mismatch adversarial checks.
separate_executor_clean_checkout_replay.limitations: Fresh execution custody is distinct from independent implementation, input, institution, human domain judgment, or scientific replication.

human_scientific_review.required_scope: Confirm preprocessing choices, the 10 ms necessary-bound interpretation, quality/injection policy, accepted boundaries, and conclusion strength.
